title: GRZO: Group-Relative Zeroth-Order Optimization for Large Language Model Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2606.02857v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization is a memory-efficient alternative to backpropagation for fine-tuning large language models, but its deployment is limited by the high variance of gradient estimation. We propose GRZO, a Group-Relative Zeroth-Order optimizer that draws one pseudo-independent perturbation per mini-batch example and aggregates the per-example losses through group-relative normalization, raising the effective gradient-direction count from one to the batch size at no additional forward cost while preserving inference-level memory. We prove that GRZO is directionally unbiased with variance shrinking proportionally to the batch size, yielding a tighter nonconvex convergence bound than MeZO. translated_title: GRZO：面向大语言模型微调的组相对零阶优化
translated_abstract: 零阶（ZO）优化是微调大语言模型时替代反向传播的一种内存高效方案，但其部署受限于梯度估计的高方差。我们提出了GRZO，一种组相对零阶优化器，它为每个小批量样本抽取一个伪独立扰动，并通过组相对归一化聚合各样本的损失，在不增加任何前向传播成本的前提下，将有效梯度方向数量从一个提升至批大小，同时保持推理级别的内存占用。我们证明GRZO在方向上是无偏的，其方差随批大小成比例缩小，从而获得了比MeZO更紧的非凸收敛界。在RoBERTa-large、Llama3-8B和OPT-13B的多个任务上，GRZO在Llama3-8B上将平均准确率较MeZO提升+3.0，同时峰值GPU内存降低23%；作为MeZO核心的直接替代方案，它提升了稀疏、低秩……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: GRZO通过为每个小批量样本生成独立扰动并用组相对归一化聚合损失，在不增加前向成本和内存的情况下将有效梯度方向数提升至批大小，显著降低梯度估计方差，在Llama3-8B上比MeZO平均准确率提升3.0且峰值GPU内存降低23%。
en_tdlr: GRZO draws one pseudo-independent perturbation per mini-batch example and aggregates losses via group-relative normalization, raising the effective gradient-direction count to the batch size at no extra forward cost or memory, improving average accuracy over MeZO by +3.0 on Llama3-8B with 23% lower peak GPU memory.
